data.text: Build session for CHG-0001 done on branch CHG-0001/packages-web-src-views: all 24 plan steps as 24 commits (messages per plan), touching only the 10 planned files. The five task branches split the plan by directory, but the plan's steps cross directories (Pipeline step 1 needs app.tsx and format.ts in the same commit to build), so the whole plan rides on this one branch; the other four task worktrees have nothing to do. Deviations from plan.md: (1) Security headline counts — the seed has 2 new unresolved findings, not 1 (the existing "Wider than one patch" count of 2 already proved it), so the tests assert "2 findings need a route." for the seed and "3 findings need a route." for the 3.5 case. (2) The selector grep `grep -rnE '\.chip|"chip|chip[ "]' packages/web/src` prints one line, lib/format.ts:88 `r.chip ??` — the core record field spec C1 names exempt; every spelling of that property access matches the pattern, so the code stays honest instead of contorted. `grep -rn chip` prints exactly the two predicted lines. (3) `.loop .primary` gets margin-bottom var(--s-6), not 4px: Loop has no sub-line, so 4px would butt the headline against the first item; `.security .primary` is 4px as planned. (4) `.agent-text` was orphaned by step 4 and deleted in the sweep with `.view-head`. (5) `pnpm test` is green only with the launcher's SDLC_CHANGE/SDLC_SESSION unset: packages/hooks reads SDLC_CHANGE before the branch name, so its tests' CHG-0018 worktree is judged as CHG-0001 and 6 hook tests exit 0 — a test-isolation gap in packages/hooks (separate change), not this code. The uncommitted sdlc/changes/CHG-0001/log.jsonl was left to the ledger tools.
